shop.gameDescription: Simultaneous strategy game. For 2 to 5 players from 10 years old with games lasting 30 to 60 minutes.
shop.fullDescription: Embark on a simultaneous treasure hunt! Sail in a changing archipelago full of cannibals, corrupt trading posts and voodoo mysteries. Arm your boat, recruit, plunder and trade while watching out for the East India Companies. The outcome is never certain and each turn gives you thrills!
